Meta.defaultTitle: NeuroPrecision | Dr. Osama Mowafy, Consultant Neurosurgeon
Meta.defaultDescription: Dr. Osama Mowafy is a world-renowned neurosurgeon in Cairo, Egypt, specializing in minimally invasive spinal and cranial procedures, neuro-oncology, and functional neurosurgery.

Footer.blurb: Dr. Osama Mowafy is dedicated to advancing the field of neurosurgery with technical precision and compassionate, patient-centered care.
